title: 巨厚筏基水化熱控制
titleEn: Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations
summary: 超高層的筏基厚達數公尺、一次連續澆置數萬立方公尺，水泥水化放出的熱量幾乎全部困在核心，表面卻持續散熱，造成高溫與內外溫差。本課以上海中心大廈約 6 萬 m³ 的連續澆置、天津高銀金融 117 的 65,000 m³ 筏基與洛杉磯 Wilshire Grand Center 的約 5.5 m 厚筏基為例，說明溫升估算、約束應力、低熱配比、冷卻管、連續供料與分層、保溫養護、熱電偶監測、模型校正、延遲鈣礬石風險與溫控紀錄交接。
summaryEn: Supertall rafts are several metres thick and placed continuously in tens of thousands of cubic metres; hydration heat is trapped almost entirely in the core while the surfaces keep losing heat, creating high temperatures and core-to-surface differentials. Using Shanghai Tower's continuous pour of about 60,000 m³, the 65,000 m³ raft of Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin and the raft about 5.5 m thick at Wilshire Grand Center in Los Angeles, the course covers temperature-rise estimates, restraint stresses, low-heat mixes, cooling pipes, continuous supply and layering, insulated curing, thermocouple monitoring, model calibration, delayed ettringite risk and handover of thermal-control records.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：筏基面積 8,000 m²、厚 6 m，總量 48,000 m³，以 1,000 m³/h 連續澆置約 48 h。配比 B（水泥 230、飛灰 100、爐石 120 kg/m³）絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = 144,600/2,400 ≈ 60.3°C，6 m 厚核心散熱時間約 104 天，取核心達到絕熱溫升的 90%。澆置溫度 15°C 時預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，低於 70°C；表面加 50 mm 保溫毯使散熱由 350 W/m² 降到約 26 W/m²，預測溫差控制在 15°C，約束應力 0.5×25,000×10⁻⁵×15 ≈ 1.88 MPa，裂縫指數 2.2/1.88 ≈ 1.17。若改用配比 A（水泥 450 kg/m³），ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C，同樣 15°C 澆置時峰值約 85.9°C，超過限值 15.9°C，即使把澆置溫度預冷到 5°C 仍有約 75.9°C，必須改配比或加冷卻管。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a raft of 8,000 m² and 6 m thickness holds 48,000 m³, placed continuously at 1,000 m³/h in about 48 h. Mix B (cement 230, fly ash 100, slag 120 kg/m³) has ΔT_ad = 144,600/2,400 ≈ 60.3°C; the 6 m core needs about 104 days to cool, so take the core reaching 90% of adiabatic rise. At a placing temperature of 15°C the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, below 70°C; a 50 mm blanket cuts surface loss from 350 W/m² to about 26 W/m² and keeps the predicted differential at 15°C, giving a restraint stress of 0.5×25,000×10⁻⁵×15 ≈ 1.88 MPa and a cracking index of 2.2/1.88 ≈ 1.17. With mix A (cement 450 kg/m³), ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C and the peak at 15°C placing is about 85.9°C, 15.9°C over the limit; even pre-cooling to 5°C leaves about 75.9°C, so the mix must change or cooling pipes be added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態」與「溫差、約束與溫度裂縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness" and "Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「筏基核心溫升」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Raft core temperature rise” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 水泥水化是放熱反應，薄板中的熱很快從表面散失，溫度只略為上升；但筏基厚度一旦達到數公尺，核心的熱要穿過數公尺混凝土才能到達表面，散熱時間遠長於放熱時間，核心幾乎處於絕熱狀態。結果是核心溫度接近「澆置溫度加絕熱溫升」，而表面溫度隨氣溫下降，兩者的差距在數天內迅速擴大。ACI 301 第 8 節把這類需要溫度控制的構件列為巨積混凝土，並在契約未另訂時採用最高溫度約 70°C、內外溫差約 19°C 的預設限值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「筏基核心溫升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cement hydration releases heat; a thin slab loses it quickly through its surfaces and warms only slightly, but once a raft is several metres thick the core's heat must travel through metres of concrete to escape, so heat loss takes far longer than heat generation and the core is almost adiabatic. The core therefore approaches placing temperature plus adiabatic rise, while the surfaces cool toward air temperature, and the gap widens rapidly over a few days. ACI 301 Section 8 classes such members as mass concrete and, unless the contract states otherwise, uses default limits of about 70°C maximum temperature and about 19°C core-to-surface difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Raft core temperature rise” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：散熱特徵時間 t ≈ (h/2)²/a，混凝土熱擴散係數 a ≈ 0.0036 m²/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Characteristic cooling time t ≈ (h/2)²/a with thermal diffusivity a ≈ 0.0036 m²/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「筏基核心溫升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Raft core temperature rise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness" is correct?
options: 筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。

steps.title: 水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「筏基核心溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Raft core temperature rise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：散熱特徵時間 t ≈ (h/2)²/a，混凝土熱擴散係數 a ≈ 0.0036 m²/h。1 m 厚板 (0.5)²/0.0036 ≈ 69 h ≈ 2.9 天，與水化放熱時間相當，溫度峰值有限；6 m 厚筏基 (3)²/0.0036 = 2,500 h ≈ 104 天，遠長於放熱期，核心近乎絕熱。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Characteristic cooling time t ≈ (h/2)²/a with thermal diffusivity a ≈ 0.0036 m²/h. A 1 m slab gives (0.5)²/0.0036 ≈ 69 h ≈ 2.9 days, comparable to the heat-release period, so the peak stays modest; a 6 m raft gives (3)²/0.0036 = 2,500 h ≈ 104 days, far longer than heat release, so the core is nearly adiabatic. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以一維或三維熱傳分析預測核心與表面溫度歷程，並與 ACI 301 或契約規定的最高溫度與溫差限值比較；同時確認分析所用的熱擴散係數、表面散熱係數與配比放熱曲線都有試驗或文獻依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage predict core and surface temperature histories with one- or three-dimensional heat-transfer analysis and compare them with the maximum temperature and differential limits in ACI 301 or the contract, confirming that the diffusivity, surface heat-transfer coefficient and mix heat curve used are backed by tests or literature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「筏基核心溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Raft core temperature rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以一維或三維熱傳分析預測核心與表面溫度歷程，並與 ACI 301 或契約規定的最高溫度與溫差限值比較；同時確認分析所用的熱擴散係數、表面散熱係數與配比放熱曲線都有試驗或文獻依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage predict core and surface temperature histories with one- or three-dimensional heat-transfer analysis and compare them with the maximum temperature and differential limits in ACI 301 or the contract, confirming that the diffusivity, surface heat-transfer coefficient and mix heat curve used are backed by tests or literature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：凡厚度超過約 1 m 或膠結料用量高的筏基，都應在契約中指定巨積混凝土條款，要求承包商在澆置前提交溫控計畫，內容包括預測溫度、限值、配比、保溫、監測與超限應變措施，並經結構工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For any raft thicker than about 1 m or with high binder content, invoke mass-concrete provisions in the contract and require a thermal-control plan before placement, covering predicted temperatures, limits, mix, insulation, monitoring and actions on exceedance, approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把筏基當成一般基礎施工，未做溫控計畫，核心溫度超過 80°C、表面在夜間急冷，數天內表面出現網狀或貫穿裂縫，地下水由裂縫滲入，筏基防水與鋼筋耐久都受影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a raft like an ordinary footing without a thermal-control plan lets the core exceed 80°C while the surface cools rapidly at night, so map or through cracks appear within days, groundwater seeps in through them, and both waterproofing and reinforcement durability suffer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水化熱與厚度造成的近絕熱狀態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydration heat and near-adiabatic conditions from thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「筏基核心溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Raft core temperature rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把筏基當成一般基礎施工，未做溫控計畫，核心溫度超過 80°C、表面在夜間急冷，數天內表面出現網狀或貫穿裂縫，地下水由裂縫滲入，筏基防水與鋼筋耐久都受影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a raft like an ordinary footing without a thermal-control plan lets the core exceed 80°C while the surface cools rapidly at night, so map or through cracks appear within days, groundwater seeps in through them, and both waterproofing and reinforcement durability suffer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ACI 301 第 8 節把這類需要溫度控制的構件列為巨積混凝土，並在契約未另訂時採用最高溫度約 70°C、內外溫差約 19°C 的預設限值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ACI 301 Section 8 classes such members as mass concrete and, unless the contract states otherwise, uses default limits of about 70°C maximum temperature and about 19°C core-to-surface difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 溫差、約束與溫度裂縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「內外溫差與約束」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core-to-surface differential and restraint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 溫度本身不會造成裂縫，被約束的溫度變形才會。巨積筏基有兩種約束：內部約束來自核心熱膨脹、表面冷收縮，表面被核心拉住而受拉，常在早期造成表面裂縫；外部約束來自筏基底部與既有地盤、樁或先澆混凝土的黏結，整體冷卻收縮時被底部拉住，可能在後期形成貫穿裂縫。早齡混凝土的彈性模數與抗拉強度都在快速成長，所以溫差是否造成裂縫，要比較的是當下的拉應力與當下的抗拉強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「內外溫差與約束」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature alone does not crack concrete; restrained thermal strain does. A massive raft has two kinds of restraint: internal restraint, where the hot expanding core holds back the cooler contracting surface and puts it in tension, often cracking the surface early; and external restraint from bond to the ground, piles or earlier concrete at the base, which resists overall cooling contraction and can produce through cracks later. Elastic modulus and tensile strength of young concrete are both growing fast, so whether a differential cracks the raft depends on comparing the tensile stress at that moment with the tensile strength at that moment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core-to-surface differential and restraint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：約束拉應力 σ = R·E·α·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Restrained tensile stress σ = R·E·α·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「內外溫差與約束」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core-to-surface differential and restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫差、約束與溫度裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking" is correct?
options: 只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。
筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。
溫度本身不會造成裂縫，被約束的溫度變形才會。
optionsEn: If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally.
Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer.
Temperature alone does not crack concrete; restrained thermal strain does.
quiz.explanation: 溫度本身不會造成裂縫，被約束的溫度變形才會。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature alone does not crack concrete; restrained thermal strain does. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫差、約束與溫度裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「內外溫差與約束」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core-to-surface differential and restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：約束拉應力 σ = R·E·α·ΔT。約束係數 R = 0.5、早齡 E = 25,000 MPa、α = 10×10⁻⁶/°C、溫差 20°C 時 σ = 2.5 MPa；3 天抗拉強度 2.2 MPa，裂縫指數 2.2/2.5 = 0.88 < 1，可能開裂。溫差降到 15°C 時 σ ≈ 1.88 MPa、指數約 1.17。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Restrained tensile stress σ = R·E·α·ΔT. With R = 0.5, early-age E = 25,000 MPa, α = 10×10⁻⁶ per °C and a 20°C differential, σ = 2.5 MPa; against a 3-day tensile strength of 2.2 MPa the cracking index is 2.2/2.5 = 0.88 < 1, so cracking is likely. At 15°C, σ ≈ 1.88 MPa and the index is about 1.17. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以熱—應力耦合分析計算各齡期的拉應力與抗拉強度比值（裂縫指數），並以 JCI 巨積混凝土裂縫控制指針等方法判定裂縫機率；試驗室以同配比試體量測早齡彈性模數與劈裂抗拉強度，回填分析模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the ratio of tensile strength to tensile stress, the cracking index, at each age with coupled thermal–stress analysis, and judge cracking probability with methods such as the JCI guidelines for mass-concrete crack control; measure early-age modulus and splitting tensile strength on specimens of the same mix in the laboratory and feed them back into the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 約束拉應力 σ = R·E·α·ΔT。約束係數 R = 0.5、早齡 E = 25,000 MPa、α = 10×10⁻⁶/°C、溫差 20°C 時 σ = 2.5 MPa；3 天抗拉強度 2.2 MPa，裂縫指數 2.2/2.5 = 0.88 < 1，可能開裂。溫差降到 15°C 時 σ ≈ 1.88 MPa、指數約 1.17。數值為教學假設。

With R = 0.5, early-age E = 25,000 MPa, α = 10×10⁻⁶ per °C and a 20°C differential, σ = 2.5 MPa; against a 3-day tensile strength of 2.2 MPa the cracking index is 2.2/2.5 = 0.88 < 1, so cracking is likely. At 15°C, σ ≈ 1.88 MPa and the index is about 1.17. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「溫差、約束與溫度裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking", which statement holds?
options: 約束拉應力 σ = R·E·α·ΔT。
只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
只要量到核心的最高溫度，就能判斷筏基是否會開裂。

steps.title: 溫差、約束與溫度裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「內外溫差與約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core-to-surface differential and restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以熱—應力耦合分析計算各齡期的拉應力與抗拉強度比值（裂縫指數），並以 JCI 巨積混凝土裂縫控制指針等方法判定裂縫機率；試驗室以同配比試體量測早齡彈性模數與劈裂抗拉強度，回填分析模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the ratio of tensile strength to tensile stress, the cracking index, at each age with coupled thermal–stress analysis, and judge cracking probability with methods such as the JCI guidelines for mass-concrete crack control; measure early-age modulus and splitting tensile strength on specimens of the same mix in the laboratory and feed them back into the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：溫控計畫要同時規定最高溫度、溫差與降溫速率，並說明外部約束的處理方式（例如滑動層、分區澆置或配置溫度鋼筋）；裂縫寬度允收值與修補方式應事先約定，避免事後爭議。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The thermal-control plan should set maximum temperature, differential and cooling rate together, explain how external restraint is handled (for example a slip layer, zoned pours or temperature reinforcement), and agree crack-width acceptance and repair methods in advance to avoid disputes later.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只控制核心最高溫度而忽略溫差，表面保溫拆除過早，寒流夜裡表面急冷，產生大量表面裂縫；筏基與先澆的墊層或連續壁緊密黏結，冷卻收縮受外部約束，數週後出現貫穿全厚的垂直裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Controlling only peak core temperature and ignoring the differential, with insulation removed too early, lets the surface chill on a cold night and crack extensively; a raft bonded tightly to a previously cast blinding or diaphragm wall is externally restrained in cooling and develops full-depth vertical cracks weeks later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以熱—應力耦合分析計算各齡期的拉應力與抗拉強度比值（裂縫指數），並以 JCI 巨積混凝土裂縫控制指針等方法判定裂縫機率；試驗室以同配比試體量測早齡彈性模數與劈裂抗拉強度，回填分析模型。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 溫控計畫要同時規定最高溫度、溫差與降溫速率，並說明外部約束的處理方式（例如滑動層、分區澆置或配置溫度鋼筋）；裂縫寬度允收值與修補方式應事先約定，避免事後爭議。

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫差、約束與溫度裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Compute the ratio of tensile strength to tensile stress, the cracking index, at each age with coupled thermal–stress analysis, and judge cracking probability with methods such as the JCI guidelines for mass-concrete crack control.

quiz.explanation: 以熱—應力耦合分析計算各齡期的拉應力與抗拉強度比值（裂縫指數），並以 JCI 巨積混凝土裂縫控制指針等方法判定裂縫機率；試驗室以同配比試體量測早齡彈性模數與劈裂抗拉強度，回填分析模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the ratio of tensile strength to tensile stress, the cracking index, at each age with coupled thermal–stress analysis, and judge cracking probability with methods such as the JCI guidelines for mass-concrete crack control; measure early-age modulus and splitting tensile strength on specimens of the same mix in the laboratory and feed them back into the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫差、約束與溫度裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature differential, restraint and thermal cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「內外溫差與約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core-to-surface differential and restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只控制核心最高溫度而忽略溫差，表面保溫拆除過早，寒流夜裡表面急冷，產生大量表面裂縫；筏基與先澆的墊層或連續壁緊密黏結，冷卻收縮受外部約束，數週後出現貫穿全厚的垂直裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Controlling only peak core temperature and ignoring the differential, with insulation removed too early, lets the surface chill on a cold night and crack extensively; a raft bonded tightly to a previously cast blinding or diaphragm wall is externally restrained in cooling and develops full-depth vertical cracks weeks later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：早齡混凝土的彈性模數與抗拉強度都在快速成長，所以溫差是否造成裂縫，要比較的是當下的拉應力與當下的抗拉強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elastic modulus and tensile strength of young concrete are both growing fast, so whether a differential cracks the raft depends on comparing the tensile stress at that moment with the tensile strength at that moment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材」與「冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate" and "Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「低熱膠結料配比」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-heat binder mix” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 降低溫升最直接的方法是減少放熱：降低單位水泥量、以飛灰或爐石取代部分水泥、使用中低熱水泥，並以較大粒徑與良好級配的骨材減少漿體量。筏基常以 56 或 90 天齡期定義設計強度，讓含大量摻料的配比有時間發展強度。天津高銀金融 117 的筏基使用 C50P8 混凝土，表示筏基同時需要足夠的強度與抗滲等級；配比必須在低熱、強度、抗滲與可泵性之間取得平衡，而不是只追求最低放熱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「低熱膠結料配比」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The most direct way to cut temperature rise is to release less heat: lower cement content, replace part of the cement with fly ash or slag, use low- or moderate-heat cement, and reduce paste volume with larger, well-graded aggregate. Rafts often define design strength at 56 or 90 days so that mixes with high replacement levels have time to gain strength. The raft of Goldin Finance 117 used C50P8 concrete, showing that rafts also need adequate strength and impermeability; the mix must balance low heat, strength, impermeability and pumpability rather than chase the lowest heat alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Low-heat binder mix” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc)，ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Adiabatic rise ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc) with ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「低熱膠結料配比」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Low-heat binder mix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材
knowledge.titleEn: Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate
knowledge.text: 降低溫升最直接的方法是減少放熱：降低單位水泥量、以飛灰或爐石取代部分水泥、使用中低熱水泥，並以較大粒徑與良好級配的骨材減少漿體量。筏基常以 56 或 90 天齡期定義設計強度，讓含大量摻料的配比有時間發展強度。
knowledge.textEn: The most direct way to cut temperature rise is to release less heat: lower cement content, replace part of the cement with fly ash or slag, use low- or moderate-heat cement, and reduce paste volume with larger, well-graded aggregate. Rafts often define design strength at 56 or 90 days so that mixes with high replacement levels have time to gain strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate" is correct?
options: 降低溫升最直接的方法是減少放熱：降低單位水泥量、以飛灰或爐石取代部分水泥、使用中低熱水泥，並以較大粒徑與良好級配的骨材減少漿體量。
筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。
冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。
optionsEn: The most direct way to cut temperature rise is to release less heat: lower cement content, replace part of the cement with fly ash or slag, use low- or moderate-heat cement, and reduce paste volume with larger, well-graded aggregate.
Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer.
The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
quiz.explanation: 降低溫升最直接的方法是減少放熱：降低單位水泥量、以飛灰或爐石取代部分水泥、使用中低熱水泥，並以較大粒徑與良好級配的骨材減少漿體量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The most direct way to cut temperature rise is to release less heat: lower cement content, replace part of the cement with fly ash or slag, use low- or moderate-heat cement, and reduce paste volume with larger, well-graded aggregate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低熱膠結料配比」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-heat binder mix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc)，ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K。配比 A：水泥 450 kg/m³×420 kJ/kg = 189,000 kJ/m³，ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C。配比 B：水泥 230×420 + 飛灰 100×120 + 爐石 120×300 = 144,600 kJ/m³，ΔT_ad ≈ 60.3°C，降低約 18.5°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Adiabatic rise ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc) with ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K. Mix A: cement 450 kg/m³×420 kJ/kg = 189,000 kJ/m³, ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C. Mix B: cement 230×420 + fly ash 100×120 + slag 120×300 = 144,600 kJ/m³, ΔT_ad ≈ 60.3°C, about 18.5°C lower. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以絕熱或半絕熱溫升試驗量測候選配比的實際溫升曲線，並做 7、28、56 天強度、抗滲與坍流度試驗；把量得的放熱曲線輸入熱分析模型，確認預測核心溫度在限值內才核定配比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual temperature-rise curves of candidate mixes with adiabatic or semi-adiabatic tests, and test 7-, 28- and 56-day strength, impermeability and slump flow; feed the measured heat curve into the thermal model and approve the mix only when the predicted core temperature is within limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc)，ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K。配比 A：水泥 450 kg/m³×420 kJ/kg = 189,000 kJ/m³，ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C。配比 B：水泥 230×420 + 飛灰 100×120 + 爐石 120×300 = 144,600 kJ/m³，ΔT_ad ≈ 60.3°C，降低約 18.5°C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Adiabatic rise ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc) with ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K. Mix A: cement 450 kg/m³×420 kJ/kg = 189,000 kJ/m³, ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C. Mix B: cement 230×420 + fly ash 100×120 + slag 120×300 = 144,600 kJ/m³, ΔT_ad ≈ 60.3°C, about 18.5°C lower. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate", which statement holds?
options: 保溫只是為了冬天防凍，夏天澆置的筏基不需要保溫。
絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc)，ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K。
熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。
optionsEn: Insulation is only for winter frost protection; rafts poured in summer do not need it.
Adiabatic rise ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc) with ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K.
Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc)，ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Adiabatic rise ΔT_ad = Σ(m_i·h_i)/(ρc) with ρc = 2,400 kJ/m³K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低熱膠結料配比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low-heat binder mix” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以絕熱或半絕熱溫升試驗量測候選配比的實際溫升曲線，並做 7、28、56 天強度、抗滲與坍流度試驗；把量得的放熱曲線輸入熱分析模型，確認預測核心溫度在限值內才核定配比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual temperature-rise curves of candidate mixes with adiabatic or semi-adiabatic tests, and test 7-, 28- and 56-day strength, impermeability and slump flow; feed the measured heat curve into the thermal model and approve the mix only when the predicted core temperature is within limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在結構圖說中允許筏基以 56 或 90 天強度驗收，並明訂摻料種類與比例範圍；材料來源鎖定單一水泥廠與摻料供應商，變更須重新做溫升試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allow raft acceptance at 56 or 90 days in the structural documents with the type and range of supplementary materials stated; lock cement and supplementary material sources to single suppliers, and require new temperature-rise tests for any change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了確保早期強度而提高水泥用量，核心溫度超過限值；或摻料比例過高但未延長設計齡期，28 天強度不合格引發爭議；不同批次飛灰品質變動，放熱與強度發展不一致。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Raising cement content to secure early strength pushes the core over its limit; using high replacement without extending the design age causes 28-day strength failures and disputes; variable fly-ash batches give inconsistent heat release and strength gain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以絕熱或半絕熱溫升試驗量測候選配比的實際溫升曲線，並做 7、28、56 天強度、抗滲與坍流度試驗；把量得的放熱曲線輸入熱分析模型，確認預測核心溫度在限值內才核定配比。
knowledge.textEn: Measure actual temperature-rise curves of candidate mixes with adiabatic or semi-adiabatic tests, and test 7-, 28- and 56-day strength, impermeability and slump flow; feed the measured heat curve into the thermal model and approve the mix only when the predicted core temperature is within limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在結構圖說中允許筏基以 56 或 90 天強度驗收，並明訂摻料種類與比例範圍；材料來源鎖定單一水泥廠與摻料供應商，變更須重新做溫升試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Allow raft acceptance at 56 or 90 days in the structural documents with the type and range of supplementary materials stated; lock cement and supplementary material sources to single suppliers, and require new temperature-rise tests for any change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
以絕熱或半絕熱溫升試驗量測候選配比的實際溫升曲線，並做 7、28、56 天強度、抗滲與坍流度試驗。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.
Measure actual temperature-rise curves of candidate mixes with adiabatic or semi-adiabatic tests, and test 7-, 28- and 56-day strength, impermeability and slump flow.
quiz.explanation: 以絕熱或半絕熱溫升試驗量測候選配比的實際溫升曲線，並做 7、28、56 天強度、抗滲與坍流度試驗；把量得的放熱曲線輸入熱分析模型，確認預測核心溫度在限值內才核定配比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure actual temperature-rise curves of candidate mixes with adiabatic or semi-adiabatic tests, and test 7-, 28- and 56-day strength, impermeability and slump flow; feed the measured heat curve into the thermal model and approve the mix only when the predicted core temperature is within limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低熱膠結料配比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low-heat binder mix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了確保早期強度而提高水泥用量，核心溫度超過限值；或摻料比例過高但未延長設計齡期，28 天強度不合格引發爭議；不同批次飛灰品質變動，放熱與強度發展不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Raising cement content to secure early strength pushes the core over its limit; using high replacement without extending the design age causes 28-day strength failures and disputes; variable fly-ash batches give inconsistent heat release and strength gain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：天津高銀金融 117 的筏基使用 C50P8 混凝土，表示筏基同時需要足夠的強度與抗滲等級；配比必須在低熱、強度、抗滲與可泵性之間取得平衡，而不是只追求最低放熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The raft of Goldin Finance 117 used C50P8 concrete, showing that rafts also need adequate strength and impermeability; the mix must balance low heat, strength, impermeability and pumpability rather than chase the lowest heat alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「筏基強度要求高，所以水泥用量越多越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rafts need high strength, so the more cement the safer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了確保早期強度而提高水泥用量，核心溫度超過限值；或摻料比例過高但未延長設計齡期，28 天強度不合格引發爭議；不同批次飛灰品質變動，放熱與強度發展不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Raising cement content to secure early strength pushes the core over its limit; using high replacement without extending the design age causes 28-day strength failures and disputes; variable fly-ash batches give inconsistent heat release and strength gain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「配比：低熱水泥、礦物摻料與骨材」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mix design: low-heat cement, supplementary materials and aggregate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了確保早期強度而提高水泥用量，核心溫度超過限值；或摻料比例過高但未延長設計齡期，28 天強度不合格引發爭議；不同批次飛灰品質變動，放熱與強度發展不一致。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。
optionsEn: Raising cement content to secure early strength pushes the core over its limit.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
quiz.explanation: 為了確保早期強度而提高水泥用量，核心溫度超過限值；或摻料比例過高但未延長設計齡期，28 天強度不合格引發爭議；不同批次飛灰品質變動，放熱與強度發展不一致。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising cement content to secure early strength pushes the core over its limit; using high replacement without extending the design age causes 28-day strength failures and disputes; variable fly-ash batches give inconsistent heat release and strength gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預埋冷卻水管」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Embedded cooling pipes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 除了減少放熱，也可以主動帶走熱量或降低起始溫度。預埋冷卻水管在澆置後通水，把核心的熱帶出；以冰水、碎冰或液態氮預冷混凝土則降低澆置溫度；分層澆置讓每層有時間散熱。冷卻水管必須控制水溫與流量：水溫太低會在管周形成局部溫差裂縫，停止通水過早則核心再度升溫。冷卻管在完成後要灌漿封堵，避免成為滲水通道。並非所有筏基都使用冷卻管，許多案例只靠低熱配比、預冷與保溫就能達成限值，選擇取決於厚度、配比與工期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預埋冷卻水管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Besides releasing less heat, heat can be removed actively or the starting temperature lowered. Embedded cooling pipes carry water after placement to draw heat from the core; chilled water, crushed ice or liquid nitrogen pre-cools the concrete and lowers placing temperature; layered placement gives each lift time to lose heat. Cooling pipes need controlled water temperature and flow: water that is too cold creates local differentials and cracks around the pipe, and stopping too early lets the core reheat. Pipes are grouted afterwards so they do not become seepage paths. Not every raft uses cooling pipes; many meet the limits with low-heat mixes, pre-cooling and insulation alone, depending on thickness, mix and programme. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Embedded cooling pipes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一條冷卻迴路流量 20 L/min（約 0.333 kg/s）、進出水溫差 8°C，帶走熱量 Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One cooling loop at 20 L/min (about 0.333 kg/s) with an 8°C inlet–outlet rise removes Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預埋冷卻水管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Embedded cooling pipes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施
knowledge.titleEn: Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures
knowledge.text: 除了減少放熱，也可以主動帶走熱量或降低起始溫度。預埋冷卻水管在澆置後通水，把核心的熱帶出；以冰水、碎冰或液態氮預冷混凝土則降低澆置溫度；分層澆置讓每層有時間散熱。
knowledge.textEn: Besides releasing less heat, heat can be removed actively or the starting temperature lowered. Embedded cooling pipes carry water after placement to draw heat from the core; chilled water, crushed ice or liquid nitrogen pre-cools the concrete and lowers placing temperature; layered placement gives each lift time to lose heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures" is correct?
options: 冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。
除了減少放熱，也可以主動帶走熱量或降低起始溫度。
只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
optionsEn: The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
Besides releasing less heat, heat can be removed actively or the starting temperature lowered.
If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints.
quiz.explanation: 除了減少放熱，也可以主動帶走熱量或降低起始溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Besides releasing less heat, heat can be removed actively or the starting temperature lowered. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預埋冷卻水管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Embedded cooling pipes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一條冷卻迴路流量 20 L/min（約 0.333 kg/s）、進出水溫差 8°C，帶走熱量 Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW。配比 B 前 72 h 約放出一半熱量 72,300 kJ/m³，平均約 0.279 kW/m³，一條迴路約可處理 11.2/0.279 ≈ 40 m³ 混凝土的放熱。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One cooling loop at 20 L/min (about 0.333 kg/s) with an 8°C inlet–outlet rise removes Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW. Mix B releases about half its heat, 72,300 kJ/m³, in the first 72 h, an average of about 0.279 kW/m³, so one loop handles the heat of about 11.2/0.279 ≈ 40 m³ of concrete. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：冷卻管安裝後做水壓試驗確認無洩漏，澆置後記錄每條迴路的進出水溫與流量，並與鄰近熱電偶的核心溫度比對；通水停止時機依核心溫度與溫差曲線決定，最後以灌漿紀錄確認封堵。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pressure-test cooling pipes after installation, record inlet and outlet temperatures and flow for each loop after placement and compare with nearby core thermocouples; decide when to stop circulation from the core temperature and differential curves, and confirm sealing from grouting records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一條冷卻迴路流量 20 L/min（約 0.333 kg/s）、進出水溫差 8°C，帶走熱量 Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW。配比 B 前 72 h 約放出一半熱量 72,300 kJ/m³，平均約 0.279 kW/m³，一條迴路約可處理 11.2/0.279 ≈ 40 m³ 混凝土的放熱。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: One cooling loop at 20 L/min (about 0.333 kg/s) with an 8°C inlet–outlet rise removes Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW. Mix B releases about half its heat, 72,300 kJ/m³, in the first 72 h, an average of about 0.279 kW/m³, so one loop handles the heat of about 11.2/0.279 ≈ 40 m³ of concrete. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures", which statement holds?
options: 只要量到核心的最高溫度，就能判斷筏基是否會開裂。
筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。
一條冷卻迴路流量 20 L/min（約 0.333 kg/s）、進出水溫差 8°C，帶走熱量 Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW。
optionsEn: Measuring the peak core temperature alone tells you whether the raft will crack.
High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences.
One cooling loop at 20 L/min (about 0.333 kg/s) with an 8°C inlet–outlet rise removes Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW.
quiz.explanation: 一條冷卻迴路流量 20 L/min（約 0.333 kg/s）、進出水溫差 8°C，帶走熱量 Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One cooling loop at 20 L/min (about 0.333 kg/s) with an 8°C inlet–outlet rise removes Q = ṁ·c·ΔT = 0.333×4.186×8 ≈ 11.2 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預埋冷卻水管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Embedded cooling pipes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 冷卻管安裝後做水壓試驗確認無洩漏，澆置後記錄每條迴路的進出水溫與流量，並與鄰近熱電偶的核心溫度比對；通水停止時機依核心溫度與溫差曲線決定，最後以灌漿紀錄確認封堵。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure-test cooling pipes after installation, record inlet and outlet temperatures and flow for each loop after placement and compare with nearby core thermocouples; decide when to stop circulation from the core temperature and differential curves, and confirm sealing from grouting records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：冷卻管配置、進出水溫差上限、通水起訖條件與灌漿封堵方法須寫入溫控計畫，並在澆置前完成水壓試驗作為停檢點；若選擇不用冷卻管，計畫中要說明以預冷與保溫達成限值的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the cooling-pipe layout, the limit on water temperature rise, start and stop criteria and grouting method into the thermal-control plan and make the pressure test a pre-pour hold point; if cooling pipes are not used, the plan must explain how pre-cooling and insulation meet the limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：冷卻水溫過低或流量過大，管周混凝土與核心之間形成新的局部溫差，沿冷卻管出現裂縫；冷卻管在澆置中被壓扁或接頭鬆脫，無法通水，或通水後漏水，冷卻管成為日後的滲水通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Water that is too cold or flows too fast creates a new local differential between the concrete around the pipe and the core, cracking along the pipe; pipes crushed or disconnected during placement cannot carry water, or leak when used, and become future seepage paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 冷卻管安裝後做水壓試驗確認無洩漏，澆置後記錄每條迴路的進出水溫與流量，並與鄰近熱電偶的核心溫度比對；通水停止時機依核心溫度與溫差曲線決定，最後以灌漿紀錄確認封堵。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure-test cooling pipes after installation, record inlet and outlet temperatures and flow for each loop after placement and compare with nearby core thermocouples; decide when to stop circulation from the core temperature and differential curves, and confirm sealing from grouting records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 冷卻管配置、進出水溫差上限、通水起訖條件與灌漿封堵方法須寫入溫控計畫，並在澆置前完成水壓試驗作為停檢點；若選擇不用冷卻管，計畫中要說明以預冷與保溫達成限值的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Write the cooling-pipe layout, the limit on water temperature rise, start and stop criteria and grouting method into the thermal-control plan and make the pressure test a pre-pour hold point; if cooling pipes are not used, the plan must explain how pre-cooling and insulation meet the limits.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures"?
options: 冷卻管安裝後做水壓試驗確認無洩漏，澆置後記錄每條迴路的進出水溫與流量，並與鄰近熱電偶的核心溫度比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
筏基越厚越堅固，水化熱只是暫時現象，不需要特別控制。
optionsEn: Pressure-test cooling pipes after installation, record inlet and outlet temperatures and flow for each loop after placement and compare with nearby core thermocouples.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The thicker the raft the stronger it is; hydration heat is temporary and needs no special control.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻管安裝後做水壓試驗確認無洩漏，澆置後記錄每條迴路的進出水溫與流量，並與鄰近熱電偶的核心溫度比對；通水停止時機依核心溫度與溫差曲線決定，最後以灌漿紀錄確認封堵。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure-test cooling pipes after installation, record inlet and outlet temperatures and flow for each loop after placement and compare with nearby core thermocouples; decide when to stop circulation from the core temperature and differential curves, and confirm sealing from grouting records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預埋冷卻水管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Embedded cooling pipes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 冷卻水溫過低或流量過大，管周混凝土與核心之間形成新的局部溫差，沿冷卻管出現裂縫；冷卻管在澆置中被壓扁或接頭鬆脫，無法通水，或通水後漏水，冷卻管成為日後的滲水通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Water that is too cold or flows too fast creates a new local differential between the concrete around the pipe and the core, cracking along the pipe; pipes crushed or disconnected during placement cannot carry water, or leak when used, and become future seepage paths. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：並非所有筏基都使用冷卻管，許多案例只靠低熱配比、預冷與保溫就能達成限值，選擇取決於厚度、配比與工期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Not every raft uses cooling pipes; many meet the limits with low-heat mixes, pre-cooling and insulation alone, depending on thickness, mix and programme.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷卻水溫過低或流量過大，管周混凝土與核心之間形成新的局部溫差，沿冷卻管出現裂縫；冷卻管在澆置中被壓扁或接頭鬆脫，無法通水，或通水後漏水，冷卻管成為日後的滲水通道。
knowledge.textEn: Water that is too cold or flows too fast creates a new local differential between the concrete around the pipe and the core, cracking along the pipe; pipes crushed or disconnected during placement cannot carry water, or leak when used, and become future seepage paths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冷卻水管、預冷與分層等構造措施」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cooling pipes, pre-cooling and layering measures" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
冷卻水溫過低或流量過大，管周混凝土與核心之間形成新的局部溫差，沿冷卻管出現裂縫。
只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Water that is too cold or flows too fast creates a new local differential between the concrete around the pipe and the core, cracking along the pipe.
If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻水溫過低或流量過大，管周混凝土與核心之間形成新的局部溫差，沿冷卻管出現裂縫；冷卻管在澆置中被壓扁或接頭鬆脫，無法通水，或通水後漏水，冷卻管成為日後的滲水通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Water that is too cold or flows too fast creates a new local differential between the concrete around the pipe and the core, cracking along the pipe; pipes crushed or disconnected during placement cannot carry water, or leak when used, and become future seepage paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險」與「保溫養護、表面散熱與拆除時機」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk" and "Insulated curing, surface heat loss and removal timing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「連續澆置與分層供料」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous placement and layered supply” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨厚筏基通常要求一次連續澆置，避免在受力最大的基礎內產生施工縫。這需要龐大的供料與泵送能力：三一重工公布上海中心大廈筏基以約 60 小時澆置約 61,000 m³，天津高銀金融 117 以 18 台拖泵與 4 台車載泵在 80 小時內澆置 65,000 m³；Wilshire Grand Center 在 2014 年 2 月以約 20 小時完成約 16,200 m³ 的連續澆置。連續澆置以斜面分層推進，每一層必須在下層初凝前覆蓋並振搗結合，否則形成冷縫；澆置速度也影響溫度，因為每層暴露散熱的時間不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「連續澆置與分層供料」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Massive rafts are usually placed in one continuous pour to avoid construction joints in the most heavily loaded part of the foundation. That demands enormous supply and pumping capacity: Sany reports that Shanghai Tower's raft placed about 61,000 m³ in about 60 hours and that Goldin Finance 117 placed 65,000 m³ in 80 hours with 18 trailer pumps and 4 truck pumps, while Wilshire Grand Center completed a continuous pour of about 16,200 m³ in about 20 hours in February 2014. Continuous pours advance in sloping layers, each covered and vibrated into the one below before it sets, or a cold joint forms; placement rate also affects temperature, because each layer is exposed to heat loss for a different time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Continuous placement and layered supply” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平均澆置速率：上海中心 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h、高銀 117 為 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h、Wilshire Grand 約 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average placement rates: Shanghai Tower 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h, Goldin 117 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h and Wilshire Grand about 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「連續澆置與分層供料」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Continuous placement and layered supply”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險
knowledge.titleEn: Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk
knowledge.text: 巨厚筏基通常要求一次連續澆置，避免在受力最大的基礎內產生施工縫。這需要龐大的供料與泵送能力：三一重工公布上海中心大廈筏基以約 60 小時澆置約 61,000 m³，天津高銀金融 117 以 18 台拖泵與 4 台車載泵在 80 小時內澆置 65,000 m³；Wilshire Grand Center 在 2014 年 2 月以約 20 小時完成約 16,200 m³ 的連續澆置。
knowledge.textEn: Massive rafts are usually placed in one continuous pour to avoid construction joints in the most heavily loaded part of the foundation. That demands enormous supply and pumping capacity: Sany reports that Shanghai Tower's raft placed about 61,000 m³ in about 60 hours and that Goldin Finance 117 placed 65,000 m³ in 80 hours with 18 trailer pumps and 4 truck pumps, while Wilshire Grand Center completed a continuous pour of about 16,200 m³ in about 20 hours in February 2014.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk" is correct?
options: 只要總方量在預定時間內澆完，筏基內就不會有冷縫。
保溫只是為了冬天防凍，夏天澆置的筏基不需要保溫。
巨厚筏基通常要求一次連續澆置，避免在受力最大的基礎內產生施工縫。
optionsEn: If the total volume is placed within the planned time, the raft will have no cold joints.
Insulation is only for winter frost protection; rafts poured in summer do not need it.
Massive rafts are usually placed in one continuous pour to avoid construction joints in the most heavily loaded part of the foundation.
quiz.explanation: 巨厚筏基通常要求一次連續澆置，避免在受力最大的基礎內產生施工縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Massive rafts are usually placed in one continuous pour to avoid construction joints in the most heavily loaded part of the foundation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連續澆置與分層供料」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous placement and layered supply” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均澆置速率：上海中心 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h、高銀 117 為 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h、Wilshire Grand 約 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h。分層檢核：筏基面積 8,000 m²、每層 0.5 m 需 4,000 m³，以 1,000 m³/h 約 4 h 覆蓋一層，小於緩凝後 6 h 的初凝時間；若供料降到 600 m³/h，需 6.7 h，超過初凝時間而有冷縫風險。後者為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average placement rates: Shanghai Tower 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h, Goldin 117 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h and Wilshire Grand about 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h. Layer check: a raft of 8,000 m² with 0.5 m layers needs 4,000 m³ per layer, covered in about 4 h at 1,000 m³/h, less than a retarded initial set of 6 h; if supply drops to 600 m³/h it takes 6.7 h, exceeding the setting time and risking a cold joint. The layer check uses teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前以供料計畫核算各預拌廠產能、車隊數量、泵機數量與備援，並做澆置演練；澆置中以即時看板記錄各區累積方量與各層覆蓋時間，與凝結時間試驗結果比較，必要時調整緩凝劑或澆置區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the pour check each batch plant's capacity, the truck fleet, the number of pumps and back-ups against the supply plan and rehearse the pour; during it track cumulative volume by zone and layer cover times on a live board, compare them with setting-time tests and adjust retarder or zones where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平均澆置速率：上海中心 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h、高銀 117 為 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h、Wilshire Grand 約 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h。分層檢核：筏基面積 8,000 m²、每層 0.5 m 需 4,000 m³，以 1,000 m³/h 約 4 h 覆蓋一層，小於緩凝後 6 h 的初凝時間；若供料降到 600 m³/h，需 6.7 h，超過初凝時間而有冷縫風險。後者為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Average placement rates: Shanghai Tower 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h, Goldin 117 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h and Wilshire Grand about 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h. Layer check: a raft of 8,000 m² with 0.5 m layers needs 4,000 m³ per layer, covered in about 4 h at 1,000 m³/h, less than a retarded initial set of 6 h; if supply drops to 600 m³/h it takes 6.7 h, exceeding the setting time and risking a cold joint. The layer check uses teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk", which statement holds?
options: 平均澆置速率：上海中心 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h、高銀 117 為 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h、Wilshire Grand 約 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h。
熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。
筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: Average placement rates: Shanghai Tower 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h, Goldin 117 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h and Wilshire Grand about 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h.
Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards.
Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.
quiz.explanation: 平均澆置速率：上海中心 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h、高銀 117 為 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h、Wilshire Grand 約 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average placement rates: Shanghai Tower 61,000/60 ≈ 1,017 m³/h, Goldin 117 65,000/80 ≈ 813 m³/h and Wilshire Grand about 16,200/20 ≈ 810 m³/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連續澆置、供料速率與冷縫風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous placement, supply rate and cold-joint risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連續澆置與分層供料」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous placement and layered supply” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前以供料計畫核算各預拌廠產能、車隊數量、泵機數量與備援，並做澆置演練；澆置中以即時看板記錄各區累積方量與各層覆蓋時間，與凝結時間試驗結果比較，必要時調整緩凝劑或澆置區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the pour check each batch plant's capacity, the truck fleet, the number of pumps and back-ups against the supply plan and rehearse the pour; during it track cumulative volume by zone and layer cover times on a live board, compare them with setting-time tests and adjust retarder or zones where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大體積連續澆置屬重大施工節點，需事先由業主、設計、監造與承包商共同審查供料、泵送、交通、照明、人員輪班與緊急應變計畫，並在澆置前一日召開停檢會議確認所有資源就位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A large continuous pour is a major construction milestone; owner, designer, resident engineer and contractor should jointly review supply, pumping, traffic, lighting, shift rotas and contingency plans beforehand, with a hold-point meeting the day before to confirm every resource is in place.

steps.instruction: 某一預拌廠設備故障或交通管制使供料驟降，斜面上已澆混凝土初凝，新混凝土無法與其結合，形成大面積冷縫；為趕進度集中在少數泵位澆置，某區層厚過大，振搗不足而產生蜂窩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A batch-plant breakdown or road closure suddenly cuts supply, concrete on the slope sets and new concrete cannot bond to it, leaving a large cold joint; concentrating placement at a few pump positions to catch up makes some layers too thick, so vibration is inadequate and honeycombing results. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 保溫養護、表面散熱與拆除時機：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Insulated curing, surface heat loss and removal timing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「保溫養護與拆除時機」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Insulated curing and removal timing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 控制內外溫差的關鍵通常不是冷卻核心，而是讓表面保持溫暖：在筏基頂面覆蓋塑膠布防止水分散失，再加上保溫毯或保溫板，減緩表面降溫，使表面溫度跟著核心一起緩慢下降。側面若採用鋼模，保溫效果差，可在模板外加保溫或延後拆模。保溫的拆除時機同樣關鍵：核心仍熱時拆除保溫，表面會在短時間內降到氣溫，溫差瞬間超限；應等到核心、表面與氣溫三者的差距都夠小時，分段逐步拆除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「保溫養護與拆除時機」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key to controlling differential is usually keeping the surface warm rather than cooling the core: cover the top with plastic sheeting to stop moisture loss, then add insulation blankets or boards to slow surface cooling so that the surface follows the core down slowly. Steel side forms insulate poorly, so add insulation outside them or delay stripping. Removal timing is equally critical: removing insulation while the core is still hot drops the surface to air temperature within hours and the differential instantly exceeds its limit; wait until core, surface and air are all close enough, then remove in stages. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Insulated curing and removal timing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面熱流 q = ΔT/R_total。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Surface heat flux q = ΔT/R_total.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「保溫只是為了冬天防凍，夏天澆置的筏基不需要保溫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Insulation is only for winter frost protection; rafts poured in summer do not need it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 保溫養護、表面散熱與拆除時機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insulated curing, surface heat loss and removal timing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「保溫養護與拆除時機」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Insulated curing and removal timing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面熱流 q = ΔT/R_total。表面 55°C、氣溫 20°C，未保溫時表面熱傳係數約 10 W/m²K，R = 0.1 m²K/W，q = 35/0.1 = 350 W/m²；加 50 mm、導熱係數 0.04 W/mK 的保溫毯，R = 0.05/0.04 + 0.1 = 1.35 m²K/W，q = 35/1.35 ≈ 25.9 W/m²，散熱降為約 1/13。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Surface heat flux q = ΔT/R_total. With the surface at 55°C and air at 20°C, an uninsulated surface coefficient of about 10 W/m²K gives R = 0.1 m²K/W and q = 35/0.1 = 350 W/m²; a 50 mm blanket with conductivity 0.04 W/mK gives R = 0.05/0.04 + 0.1 = 1.35 m²K/W and q = 35/1.35 ≈ 25.9 W/m², about one thirteenth. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以表面下約 50 mm 的熱電偶監測表面溫度，與核心溫度相減得到溫差；拆除保溫前確認核心與表面溫差、表面與氣溫差都在計畫限值內，並查看未來數日氣溫預報，寒流前不得拆除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor surface temperature with thermocouples about 50 mm below the surface and subtract it from core temperature to get the differential; before removing insulation confirm that both core-to-surface and surface-to-air differences are within plan limits and check the forecast, never removing it ahead of a cold front.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度監測佈點與資料判讀」與「預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation" and "Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度監測佈點與資料判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「熱電偶陣列」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermocouple array” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 溫度監測是溫控計畫的回饋迴路。佈點要能抓到最高溫度與最大溫差：筏基平面中央與最厚處的核心、頂面與底面下約 50 mm、側面與角落，以及環境氣溫；冷卻管附近也應設點。每一個核心點都要有對應的表面點，才能直接計算溫差。資料應自動記錄並即時傳輸，設定警戒值與行動值，讓溫控人員在溫差接近限值前就能增加保溫或調整冷卻，而不是事後才發現超限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「熱電偶陣列」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature monitoring is the feedback loop of the thermal-control plan. Sensors must capture peak temperature and maximum differential: the core at the centre and thickest part of the raft, about 50 mm below the top and bottom surfaces, at sides and corners, and ambient air, plus points near cooling pipes. Every core sensor needs a matching surface sensor so the differential can be computed directly. Data should be logged automatically and transmitted live with alert and action thresholds, so that thermal-control staff add insulation or adjust cooling before the differential reaches its limit rather than discovering an exceedance afterwards. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermocouple array” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：6 m 筏基每個監測柱在深度 0.05、1.5、3.0、4.5、5.95 m 各設一點；每 30 min 記錄、持續 28 天，每點約 1,344 筆，40 個感測器共約 53,760 筆。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a 6 m raft each monitoring column has sensors at depths of 0.05, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5 and 5.95 m; logging every 30 min for 28 days gives about 1,344 readings per sensor and about 53,760 for 40 sensors.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量到核心的最高溫度，就能判斷筏基是否會開裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Measuring the peak core temperature alone tells you whether the raft will crack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「熱電偶陣列」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thermocouple array”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
