steps.title: 溫度監測佈點與資料判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring layout and data interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱電偶陣列」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermocouple array” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：6 m 筏基每個監測柱在深度 0.05、1.5、3.0、4.5、5.95 m 各設一點；每 30 min 記錄、持續 28 天，每點約 1,344 筆，40 個感測器共約 53,760 筆。某時刻核心 68.5°C、頂面 51.0°C，溫差 17.5°C，低於 19°C 限值但已超過 17°C 的警戒值，應增加保溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a 6 m raft each monitoring column has sensors at depths of 0.05, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5 and 5.95 m; logging every 30 min for 28 days gives about 1,344 readings per sensor and about 53,760 for 40 sensors. A reading of 68.5°C in the core and 51.0°C at the top gives a 17.5°C differential, below the 19°C limit but above a 17°C alert value, so insulation should be increased. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：感測器在安裝前做冰水與溫水兩點校正，安裝時以支架固定在鋼筋上並拍照記錄深度；澆置後確認每點都有資料，若某點失效，以備援點或鄰近點補足判讀，並在報告中註明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate sensors at two points in ice water and warm water before installation, fix them to rebar on brackets and photograph their depths; after placement confirm that every point reports, cover any failed point with spare or neighbouring sensors and note it in the report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Installing sensors only in the core leaves the differential unknown; surface sensors set too deep read high and underestimate the real differential; downloading data only during office hours means night-time exceedances go unnoticed. steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「熱分析模型校正」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal model calibration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 熱分析模型的預測依賴許多假設：配比放熱曲線、澆置溫度、表面散熱係數、保溫效果與地盤溫度。實際澆置後的前兩三天，就應以監測資料校正模型：若核心溫升比預測快或高，代表放熱參數或澆置溫度被低估，後續的最高溫度、溫差與保溫拆除時機都要重新預測。分區或分次澆置的筏基，前一次的實測校正可以直接改善下一次的配比與保溫設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「熱分析模型校正」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal model predictions rest on many assumptions: the mix heat curve, placing temperature, surface heat-transfer coefficient, insulation performance and ground temperature. Within the first two or three days after placement the model should be calibrated against monitoring data: if the core heats faster or higher than predicted, the heat parameters or placing temperature were underestimated, and peak temperature, differential and insulation-removal timing must all be re-predicted. For rafts placed in zones or stages, calibration from one pour directly improves the mix and insulation design of the next. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal model calibration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱分析在澆置前做完就好，澆置後不需要再修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「熱分析模型校正」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thermal model calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thermal analysis is finished before placement and needs no revision afterwards. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 預測與實測比對、模型校正與裂縫指數更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Comparing prediction and measurement, model calibration and updated cracking index: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱分析模型校正」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal model calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預測峰值 66°C、實測 70.5°C，澆置溫度 25°C。以溫升比例校正放熱：(70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11，即實際放熱約高 11%；以此係數重算後續溫差與降溫曲線，若預測溫差將達 20°C，就必須提前加厚保溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Predicted peak 66°C, measured 70.5°C, placing temperature 25°C. Calibrate heat by the rise ratio (70.5 − 25)/(66 − 25) = 45.5/41 ≈ 1.11, so actual heat is about 11% higher; recompute later differentials and cooling curves with this factor, and if the predicted differential reaches 20°C, thicken the insulation in advance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每天把實測曲線與預測曲線疊圖比較，記錄偏差與修正後的參數；修正後的模型須由溫控負責人與結構工程師確認，並據以更新裂縫指數與保溫拆除條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay measured and predicted curves daily, recording deviations and revised parameters; have the thermal-control lead and the structural engineer confirm the revised model and update the cracking index and insulation-removal criteria from it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Ignoring early prediction errors and removing insulation on day seven as originally planned produces much larger real differentials than predicted and cracks the raft; failing to feed the first pour's measurements into the second repeats the same problem. stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高溫養護後的耐久風險」與「溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Durability risks after high-temperature curing" and "Thermal-control plan, crack survey and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High temperature and delayed ettringite” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。早期溫度若超過約 70°C，水泥水化產物中的鈣礬石可能分解，日後在潮濕環境下延遲再生成（延遲鈣礬石生成，DEF），體積膨脹造成內部裂縫，往往在數年後才出現。這是許多規範把最高溫度定在約 70°C 的主要理由之一；使用適量飛灰或爐石可降低 DEF 風險。筏基長期處於地下水中，正是 DEF 需要的潮濕條件，因此筏基的最高溫度控制比地上構件更重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. If early temperature exceeds about 70°C, ettringite in the hydration products may decompose and later re-form in moist conditions (delayed ettringite formation, DEF), expanding and cracking the concrete internally, often only after several years. This is one of the main reasons many specifications cap maximum temperature at about 70°C, and suitable fly ash or slag contents reduce DEF risk. A raft sits in groundwater for its whole life, exactly the moist condition DEF needs, so peak-temperature control matters even more for rafts than for members above ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High temperature and delayed ettringite” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High temperature and delayed ettringite”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險
knowledge.text: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。早期溫度若超過約 70°C，水泥水化產物中的鈣礬石可能分解，日後在潮濕環境下延遲再生成（延遲鈣礬石生成，DEF），體積膨脹造成內部裂縫，往往在數年後才出現。
knowledge.textEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. If early temperature exceeds about 70°C, ettringite in the hydration products may decompose and later re-form in moist conditions (delayed ettringite formation, DEF), expanding and cracking the concrete internally, often only after several years.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高溫養護後的耐久風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Durability risks after high-temperature curing" is correct?
options: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。
筏基溫度高只會影響早期裂縫，只要當時沒裂就沒有後遺症。
筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself.
High raft temperature only matters for early cracking; if it does not crack at the time there are no consequences.
Once the raft is covered nobody can see it, so crack surveys and temperature records have no lasting value.
quiz.explanation: 筏基核心溫度過高，不只造成溫差裂縫，也可能損害混凝土本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An excessively hot raft core risks more than differential cracking; it can damage the concrete itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High temperature and delayed ettringite” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。若改以配比 B 加上 15°C 澆置溫度，預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，則不超過 70°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Using mix B with a 15°C placing temperature, the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, which does not exceed 70°C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。若改以配比 B 加上 15°C 澆置溫度，預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，則不超過 70°C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Using mix B with a 15°C placing temperature, the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, which does not exceed 70°C. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高溫養護後的耐久風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Durability risks after high-temperature curing", which statement holds?
options: 只要核心溫度低於 70°C，筏基就不會產生溫度裂縫。
若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。
冷卻水越冷、流量越大，筏基的溫度裂縫就越少。
optionsEn: If the core stays below 70°C, the raft will not crack thermally.
If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days.
The colder and faster the cooling water, the fewer thermal cracks in the raft.
quiz.explanation: 若某區核心峰值 76°C、峰值後降溫速率 1.5°C/天，超過 70°C 的時間約 (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a zone peaks at 76°C in the core and cools at 1.5°C per day afterwards, it stays above 70°C for about (76 − 70)/1.5 = 4 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高溫養護後的耐久風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability risks after high-temperature curing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高溫與延遲鈣礬石」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High temperature and delayed ettringite” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以監測資料統計每一區超過 70°C 的時間與最高溫度，對超限區域評估配比中的摻料比例與硫酸鹽含量是否足以抑制 DEF；必要時鑽心以顯微分析或膨脹試驗評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From monitoring data, tabulate for each zone the time above 70°C and the peak, assess whether the supplementary-material content and sulphate level of the mix suppress DEF in zones that exceeded it, and if needed take cores for microscopy or expansion testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 核心溫度短暫超過 80°C 但當時未見裂縫，工程照常驗收；數年後筏基在地下水作用下出現不規則網狀裂縫與膨脹，修復極為困難，因為筏基上方已是整棟建築。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」如何影響巨厚筏基水化熱控制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨厚筏基完成後會被上部結構完全覆蓋，日後幾乎無法檢查；因此在被覆蓋前完成裂縫調查、修補與紀錄是交接的最後機會。調查應繪製裂縫分布圖，記錄寬度、長度與是否貫穿，判定是否需要注入環氧樹脂或其他修補。交接資料包括溫控計畫、配比與放熱試驗、澆置紀錄（時間、方量、各層覆蓋時間）、溫度監測原始資料、模型校正紀錄、不符合事項處理與裂縫修補紀錄，讓業主與未來的結構工程師理解筏基的實際狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once complete, a massive raft is entirely covered by the superstructure and can hardly be inspected again, so finishing the crack survey, repairs and records before it is covered is the last chance at handover. The survey should map cracks, recording width, length and whether they pass through, and decide whether epoxy injection or another repair is needed. Handover records include the thermal-control plan, mix and heat tests, placement logs with times, volumes and layer cover times, raw temperature data, model calibration records, nonconformance actions and crack repair records, so that the owner and future structural engineers understand the raft's real condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal-control plan and as-built records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A crack 0.3 mm wide, 300 mm deep and 50 m long needs V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L of injection; allowing 1.5 times for losses and lines, about 6.8 L should be prepared.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基被覆蓋後看不到，所以裂縫調查與溫度紀錄沒有保存價值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 溫控計畫、裂縫調查與工程交接：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫控計畫與竣工紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：裂縫寬 0.3 mm、深 300 mm、長 50 m 時，注入體積 V = 0.0003×0.3×50 = 0.0045 m³ = 4.5 L；考慮損耗與管路，實際備料約 1.5 倍，約 6.8 L。若允收寬度訂為 0.2 mm，則所有大於此值的裂縫都需納入修補清單。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Complete a full survey with crack-width gauges and photographs before the raft is covered, using ultrasonics or cores to judge depth where needed; after repair confirm filling with water-pressure tests or cores, and hand all records and temperature data to the owner for the building file.
